entries.note: Root entry: provideWeeljack, the theme preset and the layer styles.

Shared helpers (_-prefixed, outside semver). Shipped to every consumer, so it gets an own-entry row. Measured as one whole module, so every family's helpers and wj strings add up here: Loc raised it from 5 to 7 KB on 2026-11-18, when the last five families would each have crossed 5 KB.
wj-field: label, hint, error and the field context.
wj-sheet: Optimus Dialog on wide screens, the bottom Drawer on narrow ones.

wj-icon and the generated icon set (80 Lucide icons, ADR 0008). Measured as one whole module, so every icon counts here; an app pays only for WjIcon and the icons it imports (the tree-shake check in size.mjs measures the linked, production app bundle: at most 1.15 KB for WjIcon plus one icon, measured 1127 B). Adding icons raises this row by their measured gzip (2026-11-22: 4296 B for 80). Set 2026-11-22 at measured 5.39 KB gzip (5524 B) plus 0.05 KB.

WjTheme: the runtime primary and surface switch (ADR 0009). The preset is built by the root's own code (_wjThemePreset), so this row is the service alone. Set 2026-11-22 at measured 0.94 KB gzip (960 B) plus 0.04 KB.

wjNoir, the default look "Noir on zinc" re-bound from the root's _wjNoir (ADR 0010). FESM measured with its Optimus base external, so the row is the preset's own data. Set 2026-11-23 at measured 0.08 KB gzip (79 B) plus 0.04 KB: a limit of 0.12 KB is 123 B, a margin of 44 B.

wjAura, Aura's emerald at its AA step on Aura's slate (ADR 0010). FESM measured with its Optimus base external, so the row is the preset's own data. Set 2026-11-23 at measured 0.11 KB gzip (117 B) plus 0.05 KB: a limit of 0.16 KB is 164 B, a margin of 47 B.
